name: Obsidian
description: Web-accessible Obsidian desktop application for creating, linking and organizing Markdown notes.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Obsidian user home, vaults, settings, plugins and application data.

ports.name: HTTP
ports.description: Obsidian desktop GUI over HTTP. Intended for reverse proxy use.

variables.description: UID used for files created inside /config. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used for files created inside /config. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for files created by the container.
